artworks.title: The Green Gar Fish (Esox osseus)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: The image displays a long, horizontally angled fish with a protruding snout at the bottom, and a branch with green elongated leaves, small yellow flowers, and brown buds filling the upper portion. The color palette includes muted greens, browns, yellows, and a touch of pinkish patterning on the fish. The fish is partially overlapped by the branch of foliage in the foreground, with the foliage extending upwards behind the fish and across the upper part of the image.

artworks.title: The Sucking Fish (Echeneis Naucratis)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: The image shows a green plant with elongated leaves and pink flowers on the left side, and a brown fish labeled "Remora" at the bottom.

artworks.title: The Purple Jack Daw (Gracula Quiscula)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a bird perched on a rock. The bird has dark blue plumage with intricate feather details and a beak slightly open. It is standing on a rock with small tufts of grass or vegetation. The background is plain to emphasize the bird as the focal point.

artworks.title: The Coach-Whip Snake (Coluber flagellum)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: A long, dark brown snake with a textured pattern is coiled across the central portion of the image, intertwined with a flowering plant featuring bright red and pink blossoms and green leaves. The color palette includes dark brown for the snake, with touches of red and pink from the flowers and leaves in various shades of green. The snake's head is in the upper left corner, while its body curves and loops through the middle to the upper right. The floral plant sits beneath and around the snake, extending upward with some leaves and blossoms visible mostly in the bottom right half of the image.

artworks.title: The Glass Snake (Anguis ventralis)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: The image depicts a snake coiled around a stem with a flower. The snake is the largest object, alongside the flower with pink petals and a brown center. The color palette includes muted yellows, greens, pinks, browns, and black hues. The snake is positioned horizontally from the left side towards the right, with its head near the upper right corner, while the flower stands vertically from the center right, with leaves extending outwards.

artworks.title: Parrot (Le Perroquet Indien. Psittacus Minimus)
artworks.artist: Johann Michael Seligmann after George Edwards
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: The image depicts two parrots perched on a branch. The left parrot is larger than the right one. Both parrots have green plumage with red accents. The left parrot has a red patch on its tail, while the right parrot has red around its head and tail. The color palette includes green, red, and brown. The branch looks natural with some foliage and a trimmed, jagged stump. The large parrot on the left is perched on the top branch, while the smaller parrot on the right is perched slightly lower on an adjacent branch. The backdrop is clear with no significant objects, emphasizing the colors of the parrots and the branch.

artworks.title: Parrot (Le Perroquet Brunatre. Pfittacus Fulcus Mexicanus)
artworks.artist: Johann Sebastian Leitner after George Edwards
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: The image shows a colorful parrot on a tree branch with small shrubs and plants in the background. The parrot has various colors on its feathers, including green, blue, red, and brown.

artworks.title: The Guillemot and the Puffin of the Isle of Man
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: The image shows a large bird standing on a rock with red coral-like plants around it, and a smaller bird in the water in the background to the left. The color palette includes natural tones like brown, gray, and black for the birds, and muted shades of red and green for the foliage and water. The larger bird is on the right, facing right, while the smaller bird is on the left, facing left.

artworks.title: Birds of Philippines
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: The painting depicts two birds on the ground surrounded by grass. The birds have brownish-red plumage with darker bands on their wings and tails. One bird is standing while the other is resting on the ground. The background features detailed illustrations of grass and plants. The artwork portrays the beauty of avian life. The style is reminiscent of John Gerrard Keulemans.

artworks.title: Turtur Risorius
artworks.artist: William Home Lizars after Edward Lear
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a bird perched on a branch. The bird is detailed and identified as "Turtur Risorius." It rests on a green textured branch against a plain background. The bird has a black ring around its neck, soft brown plumage with intricate feather patterns, and light pink legs. Its eye is prominent and outlined within its head design. The branch is minimalist with small buds and thin twigs.

artworks.title: Phasianus Versicolor
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: The image shows a pheasant with vivid green and blue plumage and intricate golden patterns on its wings. The bird has long, patterned tail feathers extended to the right. The background includes palm trees, rocky outcrops, and distant hills.

artworks.title: Phasianus Versicolor - Female
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a female pheasant perched on a branch. The bird's plumage is colored with shades of brown, green, and black. It stands confidently on the tree branch with pinkish-red legs. In the background, there are trees, hills, mountains and an architectural element. The drawing includes labeled text identifying the species as "Phasianus Versicolor - Female."

artworks.title: Red Ringed Parrakeet
artworks.artist: William Home Lizars after William Swainson
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: Two green parakeets are perched on slender branches. One bird is upside down, and the other is upright. The parakeets are green, blue, and red, while the background foliage is brown and gray.

artworks.title: Female Crow Blackbird, Orange-Crowned Warbler, Lark Finch
artworks.artist: Alexander Lawson after Titian Ramsay Peale
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a painting of three different birds against a plain background. The birds are depicted in detail and realism. At the top, a dark bird is perched on a branch. In the middle, a smaller yellowish bird is perched on a branch. At the bottom, a light brown and white bird is standing on the ground. The illustration shows precise attention to anatomical details and colors of the birds.

artworks.title: Three Hummingbirds with Plant
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a painting of three hummingbirds surrounded by red and yellow flowers. The style is inspired by John James Audubon. The hummingbirds are depicted in various poses, highlighting their green plumage and long bills. The background is a light beige color, ensuring focus on the birds and flowers. The flowers have red petals and yellow stamens. The birds seem to interact with the flowers, conveying motion and natural harmony.

artworks.title: Stellar's Jay, Lapland Longspur and Female
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a painting of birds on a branch. The image depicts three birds: a large bird with vibrant blue plumage and a dark crest perched on a branch, and two smaller birds standing on the ground. The bird on the left has a speckled brown and white pattern, while the one on the right has a black and white face with a reddish-brown neck. The branch also has green leaves with detailed texture.

artworks.title: Polyborus Tharus, Var.
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two birds perched on a branch. The image shows two birds of prey standing on a branch. The birds have grey feathers and a reddish hue around their beaks and eyes. The birds' plumage is detailed with lines suggesting texture. The background includes soft renderings of foliage with hints of green. The branch is depicted with realistic textures in lighter and darker shades. The artistic style focuses on the accurate representation of the birds' anatomy and feathers.

artworks.title: Five Birds with Their Eggs and an Insect
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: Three large birds and one insect are shown in the image, with a set of four eggs placed vertically on the right side. The birds have predominantly gray plumage with darker wings and white accents. One bird has a black head with orange details. The color palette consists of earthy tones such as greens, browns, and hints of yellow. The largest bird is centrally positioned, sitting on a diagonal branch with its head facing the right. A smaller bird above it is facing left, seemingly pecking at an insect. On the right, a colorful bird with a yellow underbelly faces left next to the eggs. Another bird sits on a blue-tinted branch at the lower left, facing right.

artworks.title: Modello for a Ceiling: Diana and the Dead Endymion, the Judgment of Paris, and the Death of Adonis
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: This image shows mythological scenes. The drawing is divided into several sections, each filled with figures in dynamic poses from mythology. In the central portion, a group of figures is closely interacting, some standing and others seated. Surrounding this section are additional scenes with dynamic figures in motion. The drawing uses sepia tones and flowing lines, evoking classical mythology illustrations.

artworks.title: A Street with Various Buildings, Colonnades and an Arch
artworks.artist: Attributed to Zoan Andrea after Donato Bramante
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an elaborate architectural scene with classical colonnade and arches. The drawing showcases a symmetrical perspective of a monumental Renaissance-style architectural structure. It includes columns with Corinthian capitals supporting entablatures, a central archway leading to another ornate structure in the background, and decorative elements such as niches and friezes on the buildings. The precision and clarity of line work emphasize the grandeur of the architecture. The style indicates inspiration from Renaissance architects like Bramante, focusing on proportion, geometry, and classicism.

artworks.title: River God
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (lunette): 17 x 27.5 cm (6 11/16 x 10 13/16 in.)
overall: 86.3 cm (34 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Richard King Mellon Charitable Trusts
artworks.description: The image depicts a full-body drawing of a male figure. The figure is seated on a rock or similar surface, with a slightly reclined posture, leaning back on his right arm and resting his left arm on his leg. He has a muscular build, long nose, pronounced beard, and long curly hair flowing down to his shoulders. The figure appears unclothed against a plain textured background, emphasizing his form. There are no visible additional objects, and the drawing is done in fine, sweeping lines with a classical artistic style.

artworks.title: Seated Nude Boy Seen from the Back
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and black chalk on brown laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund

artworks.title: Three Goddesses: Minerva, Juno and Venus
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and black and red chalk heightened with white on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
Overall: 20 x 15.3 cm (7 7/8 x 6 in.)
support: 29.6 x 24.1 cm (11 5/8 x 9 1/2 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three nude figures standing and seated. The figures are depicted with soft, flowing lines and are surrounded by shading that adds depth. The central figure is seated on a cloud-like shape, holding a staff, while the figure on the left holds a round object resembling a tambourine. The figure on the right is accompanied by a small putti-like figure holding onto a rod or ribbon. There are lush foliage and faint structural lines in the background, adding movement to the composition. The color palette and modeling of the forms suggest a classical or Renaissance influence.

artworks.title: Title Page
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image displays an oval-shaped, vignette-style illustration featuring a large stone or book-like structure on the right side. The structure has an inscription in Italian in a classical serif typeface. Two figures in historical attire are walking towards the structure, one wearing a hat. Precise and linear brushstrokes, hatching, and cross-hatching are used for texture and shadow, notably on the stone structure and ground. The color palette is monochromatic sepia ink, creating an antique look. The horizon fades into a textured border around the scene. The composition focuses on the interaction between the figures and the structure, with minimal background details.
